t: The Sum Up Solo Lite contactless card reader offers a reliable solution for taking payments on the move. This compact, wireless payment terminal seamlessly connects via Bluetooth to any smartphone, integrating with the free SumUp app. It enables tradespeople, such as plumbers and electricians, to process secure transactions efficiently at client premises or on site. Payments are accepted via contactless, chip and PIN, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, ensuring broad customer compatibility. Designed for busy professionals, this device handles over 1000 transactions per charge without requiring any contracts or monthly fees. Lightweight design.
b: Payment via Chip & Pin or Contactless
